sentences.text: Code vs In Re : Hasina Bibi on 13 February, 2024

Bench: Debangsu Basak 13.02.2024 S.D. Allowed C.R.M.(A) 468 of 2024 In Re:- In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Nowda Police Station Case No. 332 of 2023 dated 01.10.2023 under Sections 498A/313/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Nowda Police Station Case No. 332 of 2023
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: And In Re : Hasina Bibi ...... petitioner Mr. Asraf Mondal ...for the petitioner Mr. S. Sarkar ...for the State Police filed Charge Sheet.
Father-in-law as well as the husband of the defacto- complainant were granted bail by the Jurisdictional Court.
Petitioner before us is the mother-in-law.
In such circumstance, we grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioner shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/-, with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also be subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.

The petitioner shall appear on every date before the Jurisdictional Court on and from the date fixed for appearance of the accused and in default the jurisdictional Court will pass appropriate order to secure the presence of the petitioner in Court including cancelling the anticipatory bail granted without further reference to this Court.
This application for anticipatory bail is, thus, allowed.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
